note: Triennial election of councillors (two per ward; no aldermanic elections this year), polled on Wednesday 21 May 1958. The Larne Times nomination list names all six wards; after Matthew Gillespie withdrew in West Ward the only poll was in North Ward. Eden Ward had a single nominee for two seats and one councillorship there was left vacant. Ward returns two councillors; only one nomination. McNeill returned unopposed; the second councillorship was left vacant (LT 29 May 1958 p6: 'still a vacancy for a Councillorship in Eden Ward'). seats=1 records the one seat filled. Returned unopposed. Uncertain: two-seat ward with one seat vacant; seats set to 1 (filled seats). Check how the build represents a part-vacant ward.
